DIAGNOSIS READY: Gamekeeper's thumb (Ulnar collateral ligament injury of the MCP joint of the right ring finger).
The mechanism of injury—forceful abduction of the finger by a jersey pull—is classic for a ligament tear. I am requesting an X-ray of the right hand to rule out an associated avulsion fracture or dislocation. REQUEST TEST: X_Ray_Right_Hand.
